currency: Historic rows have null currency; resolved from the active asset dimension and checked against all seven frozen anchors.
method: Select last observed daily close in each Monday-Sunday calendar week inside the five-year pre-anchor window; retain its actual observation date. Include final partial week; do not average or interpolate.
chart_geometry: Five calendar years of history and five years of forecast with an exactly centered anchor.
gaps: Break plotted lines when successive sampled observations are more than 14 days apart. Nebius includes predecessor Yandex observations before the 2022-2024 gap; no continuity is implied across the restructuring.
anchor: Forecast anchors are separate frozen observations. Equity anchor-date stored closes agree exactly. Bitcoin daily history ends 2026-09-19, before its 2026-09-20 00:00 UTC anchor; no same-date daily close is substituted.
limits: Retrospective database snapshot, not a point-in-time data vintage available to the models.
Stored close is plotted without local adjustment, rebasing, interpolation, or dividend reinvestment. Corporate-action/vendor adjustment conventions are not independently reconstructed.
Stored daily close timestamps are null; dates are trading/bar labels, not verified UTC observation times.
This query is the recoverable source for these charts; original vendor HTTP receipts are not asserted.
distribution: The historical daily, weekly and superseded monthly price CSVs are excluded from the public archive. Source hashes document privately retained inputs; they do not imply that these files are bundled.
